_comment: Small narrative decisions. Each resolves once per universe (UniverseState.decision_log). Selection per area: DecisionRules.select_for_area — unresolved decisions whose appears_in_biomes contains the area's biome (and whose appears_at_landmarks, if present, contains the destination) ordered by priority then id; the first one is the area's single NPC. Effects: morality -> character; reputation -> universe factions; haul -> current expedition; recruits -> settlement.pending_recruits; health -> protagonist (never below 1). Options may carry requires_haul and requires_reputation {faction, min, max, hide_when_blocked}; prompts_by_reputation picks the prompt text by the player's standing with a faction (first match wins, else prompt).

stranded_survivor.title: A stranded survivor
stranded_survivor.prompt: A woman in Crown colours sits against a stump, leg bound with a torn cloak. A pack of supplies lies beside her. She says her patrol left her when the hounds came. She asks for food to make it to Emberfall.

help.label: Share two food and point her to Emberfall
help.result: She limps off toward the village. One more mouth, one more pair of hands.

rob.label: Take her pack. She won't need it.
rob.result: She doesn't scream. That is somehow worse. The pack is heavier than it looked.

ignore.label: Walk on. The Marches are full of the dying.

crown_patrol.title: A Crown patrol
crown_patrol.prompt: Four riders in Aurel blue block the road, lances couched. The sergeant looks you over, hand resting on her hilt, and asks what business a survivor of Emberfall has this far from the ashes.

prompts_by_reputation.text: Four riders in Aurel blue rein in on the road. The sergeant raises an open hand. 'Emberfall's survivor — the one who sent Ysolde home. The Crown remembers its debts, and the Border Fort could use someone who knows these trails.'
Four riders in Aurel blue block the road, lances couched. The sergeant's hand goes to her sword. 'That's the one. The fort has your description.' Nobody dismounts to talk.

escort.label: Offer to guide them through marauder country
escort.result: A day on the old roads, and the sergeant pays in good iron. The Legion's scouts will have seen whose colours you rode beside.

trade.label: Trade news of the Marches for rations
trade.result: Marauder camps, hound tracks, the state of the crossroads. They give you two days of bread for it and ride on.

bribe.label: Buy the road with a bar of iron
bribe.result: The sergeant weighs the iron, then weighs you, and finds the iron heavier. The lances part and you walk through.

defy.label: Tell them the Marches belong to no crown
defy.result: They ride off laughing. One of them does not: a conscript with a Marches accent slips away that night and turns up at Emberfall's gate.

fight.label: Cut your way through
fight.result: You come out of it with a rider's blade and a wound that will not close for days. The Crown will not forget this road.
